The counter as it stands today, lifted from the real stylesheet — same tokens, spacing and type sizes.

Mark up anything you want changed here rather than sending a screenshot. Each artboard has Theme and Density levers above it, the same two the app actually has.
Billing is the screen that matters. Tab 1 is a walk-in, tab 2 has a customer, tab 3 is empty — the three states the strip can be in.
